main.description: Points a new branch at a commit or branch, the default branch when none is named, as `knotless branch` does. As the account logged in to this appview's web pages: directly for the owner, through the repository's gateway for a collaborator, which refuses anyone else.

errors.description: The branch exists already, there is no such commit or branch to start at, or the gateway refused it.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

from.description: The commit, by hex, or branch it starts at: the default branch when absent.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

sha.description: The commit it points at, in hex, once made.

description: Creates a branch of a repository.
